name: gm-class-look
author: Ragnarok Offline
description: Draws GM accounts as their class -- job outfit, costumes and hairstyle -- instead of the GM suit. GM commands are unchanged. Off until you turn it on.

settings.label: Keep the GM name style
settings.description: Turn this off to show a GM's name like anyone else's.

settings.label: Keep GM-styled chat
settings.description: Turn this off to show what a GM says like anyone else's chat.
